Ben / Marissa / Diane —

Draft redline suggestions below (high level). Ill push a tracked PDF later today. Please review and let me know any commercial tradeoffs youd like reflected.

1) Measurement Appendix (suggested language): 
"Availability shall be calculated monthly as (1 - (total minutes of unavailability / total minutes in measurement period)) * 100, where unavailability is defined as failed or timed-out customer API requests as measured by Redwood's synthetic probes and corroborated by server-side error logs. Redwood will provide a per-account availability report on request. Regional weighting: uptime is computed across the set of regions serving the account and weighted by request volume per region during the measurement period."

2) Scheduled Maintenance (suggested language):
"Scheduled maintenance" means non-emergency activities reasonably necessary for patching, upgrades, or capacity changes and scheduled at least five (5) business days in advance. Redwood shall limit scheduled maintenance to no more than six (6) hours per maintenance window and up to four (4) windows per calendar quarter. Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to schedule maintenance during off-peak hours for the Customer. Scheduled maintenance will be excluded from service credit calculations provided that proper notice was delivered.

3) Blackout Days and Emergency Patching:
"Customer may designate up to three (3) Blackout Days per calendar year on which Scheduled Maintenance will not be performed. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Redwood may perform emergency security or stability patches during a Customer Blackout Day if Redwood reasonably determines such action is necessary to protect service security or integrity, provided Redwood notifies Customer as soon as practical and documents the rationale. Emergency maintenance that results in unavailability may be excluded from service credit if Redwood demonstrates the action was an emergency security remediation; otherwise standard credit calculations apply."

4) Service Credit Mechanics:
"Service credits shall be applied as a pro-rated credit against the monthly invoice for the affected month. At Customer's election within thirty (30) days of the credit being issued, the credit may instead be applied as equivalent service days to be used against professional services or future support add-ons, subject to mutual agreement. The aggregate monthly credit shall not exceed twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly fees for the affected Service."
